Those symptoms of burning pain, weakness, paresthesias, absent reflexes, decreased grip, and fasciculations point strongly to a cervical myelopathy, not a urinary tract infection. Please describe if you have any issues with bowel or bladder control, and tell me if you notice any difficulty walking or balancing.
